name: Dust Devil Debris
summary: Across Westfall, Dust Devils leave charged grit in their wake. Mages value this debris as a reagent for enchanting parchment and binding messaging spells into scrolls.

sections.title: Air Spun into Parchment
sections.body: Dust Devils sweep across Westfall’s plains as violent whirlwinds. When one is struck down, the living storm collapses into charged dust and grit called Dust Devil Debris. A faint trace of the elemental vortex remains in the residue. In Stormwind, arcane practitioners such as Collin Mauren prize it for specialized sorcery. Infused into enchanted ink and parchment, the grit helps a wizard bind an airy messaging spell to a scroll, carrying words across the kingdom.

faq.q: What is Dust Devil Debris used for?
faq.answer: Collin Mauren uses Dust Devil Debris to craft a specialized messaging scroll. Its lingering elemental energy helps him place delicate communication magic on paper.

faq.q: Where does this debris come from?
faq.answer: Dust Devil Debris comes from the remains of Dust Devils, hostile air elementals roaming Westfall’s barren farmlands and roads.
Dust Devils are hostile air elementals that roam Westfall. Collin Mauren warns that collecting their debris means facing dangerous creatures.
Collin Mauren is a human mage in Stormwind’s Mage Quarter. He uses his arcane expertise to craft enchanted scrolls and magical components for fellow practitioners and curious researchers.

angles.text: As a mage, you can see how elemental remnants serve scribing and communication magic, joining raw elemental chaos with arcane discipline.
